crossRefs.note: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.
He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in…
who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
“ ‘ “Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it;’ whereas…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given us to devour.’
translations.bsb: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard every contemptuous word you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said, ‘They are desolate; they are given to us to devour!’
translations.kjv: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
translations.asv: And thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, have heard all thy revilings which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.
